items.title: 16.1 Talaba ke liye aam hidayaat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.1 with the chapter's opening paragraph, printed page 337.

blocks.text: Chemistry laboratory chemist ki workshop hai: aisi jagah jahan talib-e-ilm ko muqarrar tareeqon (procedures) par chal kar maddon ki physical aur kimiyai khusoosiyat ka mushahida karna sikhaya jata hai. Laboratory ka kaam shuru karne se pehle talib-e-ilm ko laboratory ki tarteeb aur laboratory ki mez aur side shelves par di gayi fittings se waqif ho jana chahiye.

items: Talaba se lab mein har waqt zimmedarana rawayye ki tawaqqo hai.
Lab mein akele kaam na karein; tajurbe lab instructor aur doosre laboratory staff ki maujoodgi mein kiye jate hain.
Kaam karte waqt hamesha lab coat aur safety goggles pehnein; kaam shuru karne se pehle scarf aur baal bandh lein.
Koi bhi kaam shuru karne se pehle kisi bhi equipment ya tajurbe ke mumkina khatraat (hazards) maloom karein, aur har qeemat par munasib hifazati ehtiyaat ki pabandi karein.
Lab mein bheer na ho: ek doosre se mehfooz faasle par apni kaam ki jagah par rahein.
Lab mein khane ki cheezein na layein; kisi compound ya gas ko kabhi chakhein ya soonghein nahi.
Koi bhi hadsa ya sheeshe ke saman ka tootna laboratory ke incharge ko foran batayein.
Agar aap kisi instrument ya equipment ko theek se nahi sambhal sakte to instructor se madad lein.
Chemicals nali mein na bahayein aur kimiyai fuzla (waste) phenkne ke liye sewer istemal na karein.
Lab mein lage warning signs par amal karein.

blocks.prompt: Ek talib-e-ilm instructor ke din bhar ke liye jane ke baad naya apparatus azmana chahta hai. Kaun si hidayaat lagu hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Das mein se do: kabhi akele kaam na karein, kyunke tajurbe sirf instructor aur laboratory staff ki maujoodgi mein hote hain; aur jab naya apparatus istemal karna na aata ho to us se tajurba karne ke bajaye instructor se madad maangein.

items: Zimmedarana rawayya; kabhi akele nahi; lab coat aur goggles, baal bandhe; pehle khatraat jaanein; bheer nahi; khana nahi, chakhna ya soonghna nahi; hadse report karein; madad maangein; nali mein kuch nahi; warning signs par amal.
